notes.title: For gamers
notes.content:
Hello all,

Thank you for your attention - we are really appreciate that.

Elven Legend 2 - The Bewitched Tree - is the sequel of Elven Legend, our first game. You can find it on Steam too!

We hope that you will like it as we do.

Enjoy!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/593410/Elven_Legend/
